findings.current: Blades flashed, and heads flew across the battlefield.
findings.defect: The source depicts heads springing upward in scattered places as blades flash; “flew across the battlefield” adds a different direction and trajectory.
findings.rationale: 곳곳에서 솟구치는 목 describes heads surging or springing up here and there, matching the accepted baseline’s image rather than heads flying across the battlefield.
findings.replacement: Blades flashed, and heads sprang up all over the battlefield.

findings.defect: The next source beat—that he had already been sufficiently afraid earlier—is omitted, removing the stated reason he can now face the Blood Lord without fear.
findings.rationale: 그보다 앞서 이미 충분히 두려워했기에 explicitly says he had already experienced enough fear beforehand; the accepted baseline preserves this beat.
findings.replacement: But Jin Taekyung wasn’t afraid. He had already been afraid enough before now.

summary: The assembled copy is largely faithful, but it changes one physical image and omits a brief emotional beat preserved in the source and accepted baseline.
